name: pick, dismiss, acceptAll and submit with decisions
description: A pick confirms an option, moves the focus to the next open cue and reviews at once with the Decisions block in the draft. A dismissed cue goes to the Dismissed line and is not shown again. acceptAll confirms every default shown. Submit attaches the confirmed decisions, never an unconfirmed default, and resets.

event.text:

expect.prompt:

<<<

>>>

decisions: Cache entries are separate per user.
